intent: Design an agentic system framed as a startup company structure — flat, low-bureaucracy — where a founder orchestrator delegates work to IC agents and synthesizes results back into a coherent deliverable that respects user intent.
tldr: Landing page docs/index.html shipped through full IC loop (designer ‖ marketer → builder → critic) with conditional verdict resolved inline (1 major dismissed, 2 minors fixed, 1 deferred); v1 topology validated end-to-end.
mental_model: Conditional → go transition as loop maturity signal: founder must triage critic findings, dismiss false positives with evidence, fix trivial ones inline, defer with explicit reason — not blanket-accept or blanket-fix.

Inline fix vs Builder re-dispatch tradeoff: 2-line a11y patch (skip-nav + aria-hidden removal) is below dispatch overhead; founder edits directly and logs decision, exercising the 'no IC for one-line task' anti-pattern guard.

Critic miscount as a dry-run finding: even with structured contracts, ICs make arithmetic errors; founder must verify claims against the artifact, not trust IC summaries (Marketer self-reported 17 words, actual is 16).
Marketer's only-write privilege exercised cleanly: ## Positioning now contains one-liner, ICP, value prop, and three objections — proves the write-asymmetry rule survives contact with a real fan-out.

Dry-run completeness: every founder-loop edge has fired at least once — restate intent, parallel fan-out, serial dispatch, synthesis with conflict, critic ship gate, two stage-reports, inline conflict resolution. Topology v1 validated end-to-end.
